title: Latihan 1: Kalkulator Estimasi Ukuran Video Streaming Uncompressed vs Compressed
instruction: Tuliskan fungsi Python `estimate_video_streaming(width, height, fps, duration_sec, target_bitrate_kbps)` yang mengembalikan dictionary berisi ukuran mentah RGB tak terkompresi (GB), ukuran terkompresi pada bitrate target (MB), dan rasio kompresi data.
solution:
def estimate_video_streaming(width: int, height: int, fps: int, duration_sec: float, target_bitrate_kbps: float) -> dict:
    raw_bytes = width * height * 3 * fps * duration_sec
    raw_gb = round(raw_bytes / (1024 ** 3), 3)
    
    compressed_bytes = (target_bitrate_kbps * 1000 / 8.0) * duration_sec
    compressed_mb = round(compressed_bytes / (1024 ** 2), 2)
    
    cr = round(raw_bytes / compressed_bytes, 1) if compressed_bytes > 0 else 0.0
    return {
        'raw_size_gb': raw_gb,
        'compressed_size_mb': compressed_mb,
        'compression_ratio': cr
    }
